description.sv: World Skates officiella Vert Open 2026 — internationell elittävling i vert-ramp på Shenzhen Universiade Sports Centre, med 30 000 USD i prispengar (Men/Women Open) samt en junior-klass (Under 16) utan prispengar. World Skate-godkänt event.
description.en: World Skate's official Vert Open 2026 — an international elite vertical-ramp competition at the Shenzhen Universiade Sports Centre, with USD 30,000 in prize money (Men/Women Open) plus a Junior category (Under 16) without prize money. A World Skate approved event.

source.note: From World Skate's official Bulletin #01 (PDF, dated 18/09/2026 — note the bulletin itself has a typo, '18/09/202' with the last digit cut off, but context makes 2026 clear). Competition runs Nov 26-29 with athlete check-in required Nov 25 (not included in startDate — only the actual practice/competition days are). Exact daily schedule was NOT yet published ('detailed event schedule will be published in the second Bulletin') — 09:00-18:00 is an unconfirmed placeholder covering the whole span, not real daily times. No direct event webpage URL was given in the bulletin, so officialUrl falls back to the main worldskate.org site; contact for questions is skateboarding@worldskate.org, and for visa/accommodation: Yuna, yuanyang@sebaclub.com. Coordinates are Longgang District, Shenzhen approximations, not the exact venue pin.
